name: pi-go
tagline_zh: 用 Go 写 AI 编程代理？别从零造轮子。这个集合给你现成的模块，直接拼装，省下周末。
tagline_en: Building an AI coding agent in Go? Skip the boilerplate. This collection gives you ready modules to assemble—save.
desc_en: Go implementation of AI coding agent
why_zh: 同类多是 Python 或玩具级，这个 Go 实现专注生产级，模块化设计让你按需取用，不绑架架构。
why_en: Unlike toy Python demos, this Go collection is production-focused with modular design—pick what you need, no framework lock-in.
